errors.text_span: Die blaue Balkenreihe stellt den Saldo (rechte Skala) dar, der sich im gesamten Zeitraum negativ bewegt und zwischen etwa -150 und -200 Milliarden US-Dollar schwankt
errors.evidence: The 'Saldo' is represented by bars, not a line, and the description incorrectly refers to it as a 'Balkenreihe' (bar series) while treating it as a line. The bars do not 'schwankt' (fluctuate) but show a clear trend of increasing negative values.
The description does not mention that the bars start at height 0 of the right scale and grow longer over time.
The description does not explicitly state the repeated '2023' labels on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: schwankt zwischen etwa -150 und -200 Milliarden US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The figure does not show the 'Saldo' fluctuating between -150 and -200; it shows a clear trend of increasing negative values without such specific fluctuations.
